title: orchis cordigera var. klingei
intro: Orchis cordigera var. klingei, commonly known as the Himalayan Orchid, is a species of orchid that is native to the Himalayan region. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its bronchodilatory and mucolytic effects, which help to relieve congestion and promote the clearance of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Orchis cordigera var. klingei include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
